fields.name: slot
fields.coerce: any truthy value selects the equipment path; then used as a key of `player.slots`
fields.description: The equipment slot of the item to activate. A true value selects the variant Equipment; absent or false selects the variant Inventory.

confirm.note: The handler reads only `slot` and, without it, `num`

fields.name: slot
fields.coerce: any truthy value selects this path; then used as a key of `player.slots`
fields.description: The equipment slot of the item to activate: `etherealamulet`, `angelwings`, `tristone` or `darktristone`. A trade slot (`trade1` to `trade48`) does nothing.

responses.name: Updated
responses.when: `angelwings`, `tristone` and `darktristone`. There is no `game_response` success reply.
responses.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `skin` shows the new temporary skin (`tskin || skin`, node/server.js:918). The server does not send `tskin` itself: when the item clears it to `""`, `skin` is your normal skin again.

responses.name: Ethereal
responses.when: `etherealamulet`: you get the `ethereal` condition for 5,000 ms. A `player` update (not `reopen`) follows.

fields.name: code
fields.description: JavaScript for the official client: it shows the cooldown.

rows.when: The slot is empty, or it is a trade slot.
`etherealamulet`, less than 120 ms after its last use (`mssince(last_ethereal) < 120`).
`angelwings`, the `snow_angel` skin is not on, and the wings are below +8 or you are not a mage or a priest.
The item is not one of the four items above.

also.when: `etherealamulet`, after the `eval`: a normal update (`u+cid`), without `reopen`.

list.name: Inventory

fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key (`player.items[num]`), so a number or a numeric string; any other value is an empty slot

responses.name: Door unlocked
responses.when: `bkey` (unlocks `bank_b` and creates pack `items8`) or `ukey` (unlocks `bank_u` and creates pack `items24`). The server uses one key. The `player` update follows.

responses.name: Pack unlocked
responses.when: `dkey`: the server unlocks the first bank pack (`items0` to `items47`) that you do not have, and uses one key. The `player` update follows.

responses.name: Inventory updated
responses.when: Every inventory path that does not stop early. This includes an empty `num` slot and an item that has no effect here (a `frozenstone` is used up). There is no `game_response` success reply for these.
responses.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. A used item is gone from `items`.

rows.when: `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`, and you are not in the bank.
`bkey` or `ukey`, and that bank area is unlocked already. The server keeps the key.
`dkey`, and you have every pack already. The server keeps the key.

order: for `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`: `game_response` (`"door_unlocked"` or `"bank_pack_unlocked"`, a bare string) to you

failures.intro: Every failure reply is a bare string.
